headline: Billing processing gains recovery and investigation support
narrative: The billing work adds recovery from temporary failures, protection against repeated event intake, and better information for investigating failed jobs. Focused tests cover the retry and duplicate-handling paths.

sections.heading: Delivered capabilities
sections.text: Temporary failures can be retried within a limit, repeated events are filtered at intake, and failure records identify the affected jobs.

sections.heading: Delivery limits
sections.text: These changes describe code and tests. They do not establish fewer customer issues or improved production reliability. Alert policy and operational outcome measurement remain outside this work.
